method.runtime: Production build served locally, no source transforms and no store injection. Normal app effects retained; production does not replay development StrictMode effects.
method.cache: Server Cache-Control:no-store and CDP HTTP cache disabled. Cold=fresh browser context, warm=same-page Home/re-entry with existing bounded application byte cache. Warm retains workshop state; compare versions within each condition, not cold versus warm as a pure cache effect.
method.start: Navigation start is sampled before the existing Enter Mission Control action. rendererObservedAt is Three.js constructor observation, after renderer initialization; it excludes constructor cost.
method.homeGate: Every entry/home return waits for both the existing ready label and an observed original-rover mesh draw in the current connected MarsWorld renderer. This removes pre005/005 home-label readiness differences.
method.readiness: All six Group roots tagged userData.crew and the original Imported_Perseverance root attached to the scene after a renderer call returns. Mesh proxies are excluded. DOM status disappearance is separate.
method.visibility: First mesh onAfterRender callback is an actual frustum-eligible draw submission, not GPU completion or proof of unoccluded pixels.
method.parsing: GLB parse attribution uses unique byte lengths measured from the exact build assets. Parse spans include asynchronous decode/scheduling.
method.unavailable: Production rig preparation and React/progress CPU breakdown cannot be isolated without source instrumentation; see the separate matched development benchmark. Three.js resource counts are not VRAM. SwiftShader is not physical low-end hardware.
